		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:95%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;">Leases</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;line-height:95%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 8pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-size:8pt;">&#xFEFF;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:3pt 0pt 12pt;text-indent:13.7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">The Company leases real estate properties, buildings, vehicles and equipment under cancelable and non-cancelable leases. The leases expire at various times and have various renewal options. Certain leases that meet the lease capitalization criteria in accordance with ASC 840-10, &#x201C;Leases&#x201D;, have been recorded as an asset and liability at the lower of the net present value of the minimum lease payments at the inception of the lease or the fair value of the asset at the inception date. Interest rates used in computing the net present value of the lease payments are based on the Company&#x2019;s incremental borrowing rate at the inception of the lease. Rental expense of operating leases for the years ended December 31, 201</font><font style="display: inline;">7</font><font style="display: inline;">, 201</font><font style="display: inline;">6</font><font style="display: inline;"> and 201</font><font style="display: inline;">5</font><font style="display: inline;"> was </font><font style="display: inline;">$69.5</font><font style="display: inline;"> million, </font><font style="display: inline;">$69.3</font><font style="display: inline;"> million and </font><font style="display: inline;">$52.9</font><font style="display: inline;"> million, respectively.</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 5pt;text-indent:13.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;">Health</font><font style="display: inline;font-style:italic;"> Support Center Financing Lease</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;text-indent:13.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Under a financing lease arrangement which commenced on December 1, 2013, the Company is leasing from an unrelated third party a </font><font style="display: inline;">health</font><font style="display: inline;"> support center for a period of just over </font><font style="display: inline;">15</font><font style="display: inline;"> years (the &#x201C;HSC Lease&#x201D;).&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;In accordance with ASC 840-40, &#x201C;Leases &#x2013; Sale-Leaseback Transactions&#x201D;, upon commencement of the HSC Lease, the Company recorded an asset under the caption &#x201C;Buildings and improvements&#x201D; and a related financing obligation under the caption &#x201C;Long-term debt&#x201D; representing the cumulative costs incurred and funded by the unrelated third party to construct the new </font><font style="display: inline;">health</font><font style="display: inline;"> support center.&nbsp; The Company is depreciating the associated asset and amortizing the related financing obligation over the expected lease agreement term of just over 15 years.&nbsp;&nbsp;At the end of the lease term, the Company expects there to be a residual net book value of the building which will equal the remaining unamortized obligation under the HSC Lease.&nbsp;&nbsp;The remaining unamortized obligation under the HSC Lease will not require the eventual settlement in cash but will rather be offset by the residual net book value of the building at the expiration of the original lease term.</font><font style="display: inline;">&nbsp;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">&#xFEFF;</font>
		</p>
		<p style="margin:0pt;text-indent:13.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size: 10pt">
			<font style="display: inline;">Future minimum lease payments at December 31, 201</font><font style="display: inline;">7</font><font style="display: inline;">, for those leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year are as follows for the years indicated (in millions):</font>
		</p>
